| Cuisine | Restaurant | Approx. Price Range* |
|---------|------------|----------------------|
| **Mediterranean** | *Café Boulud – Oakland* | $20–$35 per person |
| **Sushi / Japanese** | *Koi Sushi & Sake Bar* | $25–$40 per person |
| **Tex‑Mex / Mexican** | *La Taquería* | $12–$22 per person |
| **Pizza / Italian** | *Pizzaiolo* | $14–$28 per person |
| **Comfort Food / American** | *The Wolf* | $18–$32 per person |

\*These ranges reflect typical menu items—drinks and specials may push it higher.
